items.title: Howie Shear interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: They did a lot of the Michael Jackson stuff and the Quincy Jones stuff with Michael Jackson.

ctx.x: Chuck Findley, Jerry Hey, Gary Grant. They did a lot of the Michael Jackson stuff and the Quincy Jones stuff with Michael Jackson. That was a big section. And Malcolm McNab is the movie guy in L.A. There’s a lot of players that had been in the scene way before I got there. And if for some reason they couldn’t make something because something came up, they would still get called again. But if I as a young guy that walked into town and got called for something and I couldn’t make it, and I called up the contractor…
I’ve had guys tell me that they had to be wary about going on the road, even if it was a good deal, because by the time they got back —
